sqlquery.from:
(select distinct cc.firstname,cc.lastname, cc.middlename, cc.othername, cc.department, cc.position, cc.primaryphone, cc.primaryemail, cm.name campaignname,
im_address.imaddress_G_GOOGLE_TALK, im_address.imaddress_AIM, im_address.imaddress_YAHOO, im_address.imaddress_SKYPE, im_address.imaddress_QQ, im_address.imaddress_MSN, im_address.imaddress_ISQ, im_address.imaddress_JABBER,
web_address.webaddress_HOME, web_address.webaddress_WORK, web_address.webaddress_HOME_PAGE, web_address.webaddress_FTP, web_address.webaddress_BLOG, web_address.webaddress_PROFILE, web_address.webaddress_OTHER,
address.address_line, address.address_city, address.address_zipcode, address.country,
(CASE cc.contacttype WHEN 1 THEN 'CRM Contact' WHEN 2 THEN 'Client' WHEN 3 THEN 'Supplier' WHEN 4 THEN 'Employee' END) as contacttype ,ca.name accountname, usr.firstname||' '||usr.lastname contactemployee from "$".crmcontact cc
left outer join "$".crmaccount ca on cc.crmaccount=ca.id left outer join "$".myuser usr on cc.owner=usr.id left outer join "$".campaign cm on cc.campaign=cm.id left outer join (select contactid, max(imaddress_G_GOOGLE_TALK) imaddress_G_GOOGLE_TALK, max(imaddress_AIM) imaddress_AIM, max(imaddress_YAHOO) imaddress_YAHOO ,max(imaddress_SKYPE) imaddress_SKYPE, max(imaddress_QQ) imaddress_QQ, max(imaddress_MSN) imaddress_MSN, max(imaddress_ISQ) imaddress_ISQ, max(imaddress_JABBER) imaddress_JABBER from (select im.contactid, case im.relationid when 12 then array_to_string(array_agg(im.value),'; ') end imaddress_G_GOOGLE_TALK, case im.relationid when 13 then array_to_string(array_agg(im.value),'; ') end imaddress_AIM, case im.relationid when 14 then array_to_string(array_agg(im.value),'; ') end imaddress_YAHOO, case im.relationid when 15 then array_to_string(array_agg(im.value),'; ') end imaddress_SKYPE, case im.relationid when 16 then array_to_string(array_agg(im.value),'; ') end imaddress_QQ, case im.relationid when 17 then array_to_string(array_agg(im.value),'; ') end imaddress_MSN, case im.relationid when 18 then array_to_string(array_agg(im.value),'; ') end imaddress_ISQ, case im.relationid when 19 then array_to_string(array_agg(im.value),'; ') end imaddress_JABBER from "$".crmcontactitemparams im where im.paramid=5 group by im.contactid, im.relationid) im_address group by contactid ) im_address on cc.id=im_address.contactid left outer join (select contactid, max(webaddress_HOME) webaddress_HOME,max(webaddress_WORK) webaddress_WORK, max(webaddress_HOME_PAGE) webaddress_HOME_PAGE, max(webaddress_FTP) webaddress_FTP, max(webaddress_BLOG) webaddress_BLOG, max(webaddress_PROFILE) webaddress_PROFILE, max(webaddress_OTHER) webaddress_OTHER from ( select im.contactid, case im.relationid when 1 then array_to_string(array_agg(im.value),'; ') end webaddress_HOME, case im.relationid when 2 then array_to_string(array_agg(im.value),'; ') end webaddress_WORK, case im.relationid when 8 then array_to_string(array_agg(im.value),'; ') end webaddress_HOME_PAGE, case im.relationid when 9 then array_to_string(array_agg(im.value),'; ') end webaddress_FTP, case im.relationid when 10 then array_to_string(array_agg(im.value),'; ') end webaddress_BLOG, case im.relationid when 11 then array_to_string(array_agg(im.value),'; ') end webaddress_PROFILE, case im.relationid when 7 then array_to_string(array_agg(im.value),'; ') end webaddress_OTHER from "$".crmcontactitemparams im where im.paramid=4 group by im.contactid, im.relationid) web_address group by contactid) web_address on cc.id=web_address.contactid left outer join (select contactid, coalesce(address,'')||' '||coalesce(addressb,'') address_line, zipCode address_zipcode, city address_city, cn.name country from "$".address add left outer join "public".country cn on add.countryid=cn.id where entitytype='contact' and relationtype=1 ) address on cc.id=address.contactid
inner join ( select distinct crmcontact_id from "$".crmcontact_contactcategory where categories_id in ( select distinct category.id from "$".contactcategoryrbac ccrbac inner join "$".contactcategory category on ccrbac.contactCategory_id=category.id where ( category.doNotShow is null or category.doNotShow is not true ) or ccrbac.userid=#?user_id?# or category.owner_id=#?user_id?# or ( ccrbac.groupid is not null and ccrbac.groupid in ( select distinct edsgroup6_.id from "$".trusteegroup edsgroup6_ inner join "$".trusteegroup_trustee members7_ on edsgroup6_.id=members7_.trusteegroup_id inner join "$".trustee edstrustee8_ on members7_.members_id=edstrustee8_.id inner join (select distinct edstrustee9_.id from "$".trustee edstrustee9_ where edstrustee9_.trusteeID=#?user_id?# and edstrustee9_.trusteetype=2) abs on edstrustee8_.id=abs.id
) ) ) ) as "contactids" on cc.id = "contactids".crmcontact_id
where cc.deleted is not true and cc.contacttype != 5 ) ccc
